### "Heygen's Customer Support and Finance just took a dive."
August 6, 2026

Overall their service has gone from okay to good and now it's unacceptable. I don't even want to think about this but I may have to look for another AI video creation platform. Since this technology is still growing and changing, the backend of the company has to stay available for communication and the finance department has to remain open to reimbursing AI mistakes and errors. I don't think customer service or finance can create rigid rules and stick to them when the AI is still learning and making mistakes.

Positive iconPros

When the video isn't correct or needs to be regenerated HeyGen was good about reimbursing credits used to regenerage.

Negative iconCons

They recently did an update without notify and preparing their current customers. Avatar Shots wasn't listed on the "home page" and I had to go to the chat help to find how to use the product. Then I was unable to "generate" my video as the system was requiring me to upgrade... I had already upgraded months ago. Then I had over 3,000 credits that I had purchased that they took away and implemented a policy that credits could not be carried over so I lost all but 600 credits. Now, they refuse to refund credits for video shots where words are mispronounced. At first I didn't mind upgrading because they were great to work with, but now it's all about how much money they can get from me. It's too bad because the product is good.

Based on my experience, I cannot recommend HeyGen. The concept is promising, but the actual video quality and consistency were simply not good enough for professional use.

Nothing at all it is too expensive and it does not do the job well. My appearance and my voice were far from being anything close or accurate.

Negative iconCons

What I liked least was the inconsistency and poor quality of the generated videos. My appearance would change between scenes, especially my hands, which sometimes had random accessories, incorrect details, or even distorted, unnatural looking fingers and hands. Despite repeated attempts to correct the output, the same problems kept occurring. I spent more time trying to fix AI generated mistakes than actually creating usable videos, which made the service frustrating and ultimately not worth paying for.

# My Honest HeyGen Review (From a Small Business Owner)
Tried HeyGen and honestly, I don’t recommend it.

The lip sync is way off, expressions feel unnatural, the voice rarely matches the tone or timing, and the hand movements are completely out of sync—it ends up looking robotic and distracting.
